_README: Plugins deliberately left un-rolled-out / un-enabled. Read by
An entry moves that plugin's rollout/enablement findings out of the red
lists into a 'PARKED ON PURPOSE' report. It does NOT change the exit code,
and it does not excuse source-tree defects (a missing bin/<crate> launcher)
or a removable superseded cache dir.
Required per entry: reason, parked_at (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional: revisit — the
starting point for reconsidering the park (a backlog id, a doc, a signal to
watch for). The key must name a crate dir or a plugin.json name under
crates/; a typo is reported, not ignored, because a typo'd park parks
nothing while reading as though it had.
Deleting an entry is how a park ends. Resolve the reason FIRST, then delete
— not the other way round (backlog a6f165cd).
